method.citationComments: Source-only pinned local redirect/date projection; comments and other argument bytes retained; original reference association guard reapplied.
method.literalValues: Additional read-only observer for aligned plain literal table cells and reviewed native displayed-name fields, without using the table writer to manufacture its own expected values.
method.faultInjection: Seven synthetic real writer families and four combined sets. Only active writer call sites were instrumented in one fresh process per set. Dispatch, independent source projections and preservation guards stayed unchanged. Every final partial candidate retained the original values and at least one safe independent correction.
method.recoveryCertificates: All 128 canonical subsets, partial/default preferences, only true-to-false restrictions, request/source/options/context/candidate tamper, and two forged Worker envelopes with erased findings were checked.

activationMatrix.independentOracle: Literal known native collector call following the reference with the explicit matching group; the new activation observer was not used to decide matrix expectations.
additionalDirectChecks: new group in an existing field
extra reference occurrence in an existing field
existing reference body changes delegated to binding guards
HTML references collectors with certified responsive 0/1

method.counting: Assertions are not articles. Top-level calculate calls include repeated/idempotence runs and fault controls, but do not inflate internal recovery attempts into article counts. Both distributions replay the same fixtures.
method.deadline: One unchanged 60-second action deadline, with at most 15 calculations across the two refusal barriers. Known extreme timeout cases were not repeated.
method.nativeAndBrowserEvidence: These suites do not claim native MediaWiki rendering or browser validation; those separate release receipts remain authoritative.

preservedHistoricalResults.laterInheritedCollectorScope: one blocking regression found; no release approval inferred from scoped passes

preservedHistoricalResults.initialNewMatrixAssertions: 15 overrestrictive expectation failures per distribution preserved
preservedHistoricalResults.disposition: Three exact candidate pairs were byte-equal to the prior released engine. Only the new matrix postcondition was refined with approval, requiring an independently verified literal following collector when a key migration is retained. No runtime source or legacy expectation changed.

observerLimits: The literal observer is not universal factual or structural validation. Different owner/table/cell counts, absent or renamed identity keys, full-name fields, captions and complex values still depend on the separate existing guards.

Changed template reference ownership requires a following certified native collector of the same group, independently of end-matter/reference writer preferences. Unchanged inherited reference lineage is not a reason to block unrelated safe corrections.
Responsive HTML collector values 0 and 1 use the existing pinned contract. Uncertified forms are retained conservatively, not declared invalid.
